name: commonplace
title: commonplace
blurb: a tumblr-esque standard.site editor — write a quick post, pick which of your publications it goes to, and it publishes straight to your own PDS as a site.standard.document record. titles are optional and default to a hash of your DID + timestamp per spec. an installable PWA with a network-first service worker that works offline. @kittokatto405.bsky.social asked for a publications editor, then kept it going across two more threads to fix reader compatibility and add offline support.
